hero.title: Request a Seabourn Cruise Quote
hero.subtitle: EXPERT GUIDANCE • PREFERRED SUITES • APPLICABLE PROMOTIONS
hero.intro: Planning a Seabourn cruise is about choosing more than a destination. The right ship, suite, itinerary, departure date and available offer can make a significant difference to your overall experience.
paragraphs: Planning a Seabourn cruise is about choosing more than a destination. The right ship, suite, itinerary, departure date and available offer can make a significant difference to your overall experience.

At Trips & Ships Luxury Travel, we help travelers plan Seabourn vacations around what matters most to them—from the ideal suite and itinerary to special occasions, expedition adventures and extended voyages.
Complete the quote request form to tell us what you are looking for, and a luxury travel advisor can help you explore the best available options.

introSection.title: Start Planning Your Seabourn Cruise
introSection.subtitle: A DEDICATED FIRST STEP TOWARD YOUR IDEAL VOYAGE
paragraphs: Whether you already know exactly which Seabourn cruise you want or you're still deciding between ships and destinations, a personalized quote is a useful first step.
Complete the quote request form to tell us what you are looking for, and a luxury travel advisor can help you explore the best available options.
introSection.conclusion: The more information you provide, the more effectively we can narrow down the options.

whyQuote.title: Why Request a Personalized Seabourn Quote?
whyQuote.subtitle: BEYOND THE ADVERTISED FARE • TOTAL VALUE EVALUATION
whyQuote.intro: Seabourn offers a range of ships, suites and itineraries, and pricing can vary considerably depending on the sailing. A personalized quote allows us to look beyond a basic advertised fare. We can help compare:

cards.title: Different Seabourn Ships
cards.subtitle: OCEAN & EXPEDITION
cards.description: Choose between Seabourn's classic ocean ships and expedition vessels based on your travel style.

cards.title: Suite Categories
cards.subtitle: SPACE & LOCATION
cards.description: Compare suite locations, space, verandas, amenities and overall value.

cards.title: Itineraries
cards.subtitle: PORTS & SEASONS
cards.description: Consider different destinations, ports and sailing dates.

cards.title: Current Offers
cards.subtitle: PROMOTIONS & PERKS
cards.description: Review applicable Seabourn promotions and special offers.

cards.title: Past-Guest Benefits
cards.subtitle: SEABOURN CLUB
cards.description: If you have sailed with Seabourn before, we can take your Seabourn Club status and applicable benefits into consideration.

cards.title: Additional Travel
cards.subtitle: DOOR-TO-DOOR LUXURY
cards.description: If your cruise is part of a larger vacation, we can help coordinate the broader travel plan.

notSureSection.title: Not Sure Which Seabourn Cruise Is Right for You?
notSureSection.subtitle: NO PRESSURE TO DECIDE • START WITH AN INSPIRATIONAL VISION
notSureSection.intro: That's completely fine. You don't need to know the exact ship or itinerary before requesting a quote. If you're deciding between options, tell us what kind of experience you're looking for. These details give your advisor a starting point for developing recommendations.

examples.text: We want a two-week luxury cruise in Europe with excellent food, smaller ports and a quiet atmosphere.
examples.label: European Mediterranean & Culture

examples.text: We're interested in Antarctica but don't know whether Seabourn Venture or Seabourn Pursuit is the better choice.
examples.label: Polar Expedition Discovery

examples.text: We're planning a special anniversary and want the best suite we can find.
examples.label: Milestone Celebration & Premium Suites

fleetSection.title: Choosing the Right Seabourn Ship
fleetSection.subtitle: THE SEABOURN FLEET • INTIMATE OCEAN SHIPS & PURPOSE-BUILT EXPEDITIONS
fleetSection.intro: Seabourn's fleet offers different experiences. If you're uncertain which ship fits your travel style, your quote request can simply say 'Not sure.'

ships.title: Seabourn Quest
ships.subtitle: CLASSIC OCEAN LUXURY
ships.description: A smaller ocean-going luxury ship with an intimate atmosphere and classic Seabourn experience.

ships.title: Seabourn Encore
ships.subtitle: MODERN DESIGN & EXPANDED DINING
ships.description: A larger ocean ship offering spacious suites, dining and an extensive range of onboard amenities.

ships.title: Seabourn Ovation
ships.subtitle: MODERN DESIGN & EXPANDED DINING
ships.description: A sister ship to Encore with a similar luxury experience and access to a broad range of destinations.

ships.title: Seabourn Venture
ships.subtitle: PURPOSE-BUILT POLAR EXPEDITION
ships.description: An expedition ship designed for destinations where exploration is the primary focus.

ships.title: Seabourn Pursuit
ships.subtitle: PURPOSE-BUILT POLAR EXPEDITION
ships.description: A purpose-built expedition ship combining Seabourn's luxury service with expedition capabilities.

suiteSection.title: Choosing the Right Seabourn Suite
suiteSection.subtitle: YOUR ACCOMMODATION • ELEVATING YOUR DAILY ONBOARD EXPERIENCE
suiteSection.intro: Your suite is an important part of the Seabourn experience. When preparing a quote, we can help you consider:

cards.title: Suite Location & Deck Placement
items: Midship suites for maximum stability in open water
Deck placement relative to observation lounges and dining venues
Quiet residential corridors away from high-traffic public areas
Unobstructed panoramic veranda views

cards.title: Space, Solariums & Premium Perks
items: Veranda Suite vs. Penthouse expanded living areas
Wintergarden Suites with private glass solarium bathtubs
Connecting suites for family and multigenerational voyages
Enhanced amenities and private airport transfers in higher categories

considerations: Suite size and interior living area
Veranda configuration and teak outdoor furniture
Overall bottom-line value vs. headline price
suiteSection.footnote: Rather than automatically choosing the least expensive suite, consider how much time you expect to spend in your accommodation and which features matter most to you.

specializedPlanning.title: Specialized Voyage Planning
specializedPlanning.subtitle: EXPEDITIONS, WORLD CRUISES & GRAND VOYAGES
specializedPlanning.intro: Seabourn offers unique journeys for adventurers and world travelers. Here is what we consider when tailoring your quote:

personas.title: Planning a Seabourn Expedition?
personas.description: If you're considering Antarctica, the Arctic, Greenland or the Kimberley, mention the destination in your request. Expedition cruises have different considerations from traditional ocean voyages.
recommendations: Daily Zodiac landings & guided kayak excursions
Wildlife viewing seasonality & polar photography
Complimentary customized Helly Hansen polar parkas
Custom expedition gear drying closets in all suites
Pre- and post-cruise luxury hotel and charter flight logistics
personas.footerNote: We can help you evaluate the itinerary as well as the ship.

personas.title: Planning a Seabourn World Cruise?
personas.description: For travelers considering a Seabourn World Cruise or Grand Voyage, early planning can be particularly important. Long voyages require additional coordination.
recommendations: Long-lead suite reservation (12–18 months in advance)
Full World Cruise vs. customized segment selection
Packing strategies across multiple seasonal climates
Complimentary laundry, medical, and Wi-Fi inclusions
Exclusive shoreside events, private gala dinners & bespoke excursions
personas.footerNote: If you are considering a World Cruise, include your approximate travel window and preferred length in your quote request.

offersSection.title: Looking for Seabourn Offers?
offersSection.subtitle: VALUE & PROMOTIONS • EVALUATING TOTAL VALUE OVER HEADLINE DISCOUNTS
offersSection.intro: When you request a quote, let us know if you're specifically interested in evaluating promotional opportunities:

pillars.title: Current Seabourn Promotions
pillars.description: Public and private promotional fares, reduced deposit events, and seasonal value packages.

pillars.title: Onboard Spending Credits
pillars.description: Promotional shipboard credit applicable toward spa treatments, vintage wines, and excursions.

pillars.title: Past-Guest Special Offers
pillars.description: Special loyalty pricing and milestone recognition rates for previous Seabourn travelers.

pillars.title: Seabourn Club Benefits
pillars.description: Stackable loyalty privileges including complimentary laundry, internet, and dining perks.

pillars.title: Suite Category Promotions
pillars.description: Complimentary veranda suite upgrades and added amenities on higher-tier accommodations.

pillars.title: Group & Multi-Suite Savings
pillars.description: Tailored amenities and pricing opportunities for families, friends, and small private groups.

offersSection.conclusion: Promotions can vary by sailing, suite category and booking conditions. The objective is to evaluate the total value of the booking, rather than simply selecting the largest advertised discount.

cards.title: Essential Details to Provide
items: Where you want to go (destination or region)
When you want to travel (dates, month, or season)
How many people are traveling in your party
Your approximate cruise budget range
Your preferred suite category, if known
Any special celebration or accessibility requirements

cards.title: The Advantage of Flexibility
items: Tell us if your travel dates are flexible by 1–2 weeks
Flexibility often opens up significantly better suite availability
Shoulder-season sailings frequently carry stronger promotional pricing
Nearby alternate ports may offer more desirable smaller-harbor calls
Your advisor can evaluate multiple departure dates side-by-side

minimumInfoSection.conclusion: If your dates or destination are flexible, tell us. Flexibility can open up additional itinerary and pricing possibilities.

faqs.question: How do I request a Seabourn cruise quote?
faqs.answer: Complete the quote request form with your preferred dates, destination, number of travelers, suite preferences and budget. You can also tell us if you are unsure which Seabourn itinerary is right for you.

faqs.question: Do I need to know which Seabourn ship I want?
faqs.answer: No. You can request a quote even if you're still deciding between Seabourn's ocean ships (Quest, Encore, Ovation) and expedition vessels (Venture, Pursuit).

faqs.question: Can I request a quote for a specific Seabourn suite?
faqs.answer: Yes. Include your preferred suite category (Veranda, Penthouse, Premium, Signature, or Wintergarden) in the request.

faqs.question: Can you help me compare Seabourn itineraries?
faqs.answer: Yes. If your dates or destinations are flexible, tell us what type of experience you're looking for and we can help narrow down suitable options.

faqs.question: Can I request a Seabourn quote for Antarctica?
faqs.answer: Yes. Include Antarctica as your preferred destination and mention any expedition preferences, Zodiac landing desires, or pre-cruise hotel plans in your request.

faqs.question: Can I request a Seabourn World Cruise quote?
faqs.answer: Yes. Include your preferred travel dates, approximate voyage length and whether you are interested in the full World Cruise or selected regional segments.

faqs.question: Can you check Seabourn promotions?
faqs.answer: Your advisor will review applicable public and private promotions, past-guest discounts, and onboard credits to compare them with fare and suite options.

faqs.question: Can I request a Seabourn quote as a solo traveler?
faqs.answer: Yes. Indicate that you are traveling solo so the quote can account for applicable solo supplements, promotional departures, and double loyalty points.

faqs.question: Can I request a quote for a family or multigenerational group?
faqs.answer: Yes. Include the number of travelers, ages of children if applicable, number of suites and any connecting-suite requirements.

faqs.question: Can you help with pre- and post-cruise travel?
faqs.answer: Yes. If your cruise is part of a larger vacation, mention your pre- or post-cruise plans for luxury hotels, private tours, and transfers in the quote request.

faqs.question: What information should I include in my quote request?
faqs.answer: Provide your destination, dates, number of travelers, preferred suite, budget and any special requirements. If you're flexible, let us know.

faqs.question: Why should I use a luxury travel advisor for a Seabourn cruise?
faqs.answer: A luxury travel advisor can help compare ships, suites, itineraries, promotions and travel arrangements while helping you build a more complete vacation around your cruise—at no extra cost.
